note: BAC Nicaragua's table of maximum credit card costs (1 October 2026): its Mastercard Clásica and Visa Clásica charge an annual interest rate of 30.00% on dollar balances (49.92% on córdoba ones) and an annual fee of 30 dollars for the holder; the dollar card is the one written.
